basic_info.description: This gracious light filled Sea Cliff residence receives an abundance of natural light and offers wonderful lush outlooks of the neighborhood. Situated near the intersection of Lake & 28th Avenue, there are no other homes across from this residence allowing for wonderful afternoon sunlight to radiate the home. Built in 1919, this home features a handsome entry foyer and large scale living & dining rooms which are ideal for entertaining. Features include beautifully refinished hardwood floors, a magnificent wood burning fireplace, large bay windows and period detail. The recently updated kitchen features an abundance of cabinetry along with a pantry area, granite countertops and new stainless steel appliances. A breakfast room just off the kitchen features a small walkout deck ideal for barbequing. At the rear of the home is a laundry room complete with a full size washer & dryer. A powder room just off the entry foyer completes the main level. The upper level features a graceful master suite which receives wonderful afternoon sunlight and offers fabulous lush outlooks of the neighborhood. The master bath features separate tub and shower, new marble tile and new plumbing fixtures. Across the upper level landing area are the two additional bedrooms and oversized sunroom. The bedrooms are both generous size and provide direct access to a large bright sunroom which was previously used as a fourth bedroom. A nicely updated second bathroom and linen closet complete the upper level of this home. The lower level of this home features an abundance of storage space and parking for two cars side by side with room for a third vehicle. Private driveway behind the property provides access to the garage. Tax records indicate approximately 2340 square feet.
